overview: Tras un evento trágico, el exdetective Lobo Rosales debe proteger a Renata, la hija de la mujer que alguna vez amó. Juntos cruzan la frontera y forjan un vínculo frágil que pondrá a prueba los límites de la lealtad, el amor y la redención.
title: Lobo, Morir Matando

overview: HENRY DAVID THOREAU examines the life and work of the 19th-century writer in the context of antebellum New England and the larger United States, as well as through the universal themes he focused on in his writings: an individual's relationship to the state, how to live an authentic life, our connection to nature, and the impact of race on American life. Set against the political and social tensions of the mid-19th century, the film traces Thoreau's journey from his early days in Concord, Massachusetts to his deep engagement with the moral crises of his time, including industrialization, slavery, war, and environmental degradation. Through his essays, journals, and landmark works such as Walden and Civil Disobedience, he became an inspiration for generations of writers, thinkers, and activists.
title: Henry David Thoreau

overview: Girls Who Like Boys Who Like Boys is an American reality television series that premiered on December 7, 2010, on the Sundance Channel. The series chronicles the lives of four gay men and their female best friends. Season 2, which saw the show relocating to Nashville, Tennessee, premiered November 18, 2011.
title: Girls Who Like Boys Who Like Boys

overview: Tired of slaving over the kitchen sink, Brenda Liversedge and Rosemary Pilgrim are keen to strike a blow for women's liberation. If this attracts the attention of their lesser halves, so much the better!
title: Girls About Town

overview: The Imperial Palace of Japan showcases peerless artworks, craftsmanship, and a tradition of thoughtful hospitality. Join us on a journey into a world of supreme aesthetic elegance.
title: The Imperial Palace

overview: Vernon Kay challenges celebs on the people and places they think they know best, while Traitors star Paul Gorton is the unreliable tour guide with the fun facts - and fibs.
title: Do You Know Your Place?

overview: As Native women vanish in Alaska, police must look to the past and a warning that went unheeded to discover the truth about a serial killer; as the net tightens, questions only grow about how many women this killer could have silenced.
title: Lost Women of Alaska

overview: At the center of the series is Constantin Buschmann, who, as a young CEO and owner, continues the life's work of his father, BRABUS founder Bodo Buschmann, and together with his team leads the family-owned company into its second generation and the future. The series follows Constantin and his partner Mili Umicevic as they navigate life as a power couple, mastering the challenge of balancing working together, brand culture and private life, while offering personal insights far beyond the BRABUS showroom. "BRABUS: One Second Wow" delivers a unique behind-the-scenes look at a global luxury brand and the people behind it – spanning hard work, intense pressure, jet-set lifestyles and international events from Beverly Hills to Milan. Featured throughout the series are select BRABUS celebrity clients and business partners from Europe and the United States.
title: BRABUS: One Second Wow

overview: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies reveals real-life missions of elite intelligence officers, taking viewers deep into the world of espionage. From covert ops behind enemy lines to the hunt for bin Laden, uncover the untold, high-stakes stories that show what it truly takes to be a spy beyond the red line of danger.
title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies

overview: In one of the tightest seasons in AFL history, Final Siren follows seven of the game's biggest names - Marcus Bontempelli, Nat Fyfe, Max Gawn, Toby Greene, Touk Miller, Cam Rayner and Dayne Zorko - as public doubt, online abuse, injuries, ageing, suspensions, and fierce rivalries threaten to derail what could be their shot at Premiership glory.
title: Final Siren: Inside the AFL

overview: It's cold, it's comforting, it's beer... but for Sam Calagione, founder of one of America's leading craft brewers Dogfish Head Brewery, beer is a passion, a business and a personal quest for best, most imaginative brews. Brew Masters follows Sam and his partners in suds as they travel the country and the world sourcing exotic ingredients and discovering ancient techniques to produce beers of astounding originality. From chocolate to mussels to tomatoes, Sam is constantly pushing his team and himself to innovate and celebrate the amazing world of beer and beer making. The imagination of the Dogfish Head team is matched only by the fun they inject into every facet of their jobs. Beer tasting meetings in the conference room with co-workers, a bocce ball league in the parking lot, filming original rap videos in the brewery plant, it's all in a day's work for Brew Masters.
title: Brew Masters

overview: Hannah Fry takes a deep dive into some of the most extraordinary human stories emerging from the world of AI, from falling in love with a chatbot to life and death decisions made by robots.
title: AI Confidential with Hannah Fry

overview: When Gary Allen is acquitted of murdering Samantha Class in 2000, detectives know it's only a matter of time before he strikes again. In 2019, the murder of another woman, Alena Grlakova, leads detectives once again to Gary Allen, unearthing chilling evidence which changes the course of the investigation and entwines Alena and Samantha's cases forever. Can he finally be brought to justice?
title: Chasing A Killer: Gary Allen

overview: Long ago... In a time of myth and legend, when ancient gods plagued man with suffering - only one man dared to challenge their power. Hercules! Kevin Sorbo's fresh, hip and good-natured spin on the legendary hero carried this witty, adventure-filled action drama to high critical acclaim. Smartly combining ancient myth with contemporary sensibilities, the series became one of television's highest rated programs.
title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys

overview: Eurovision Classical Concerts celebrates four talented and versatile ensembles that not only love and perform the classics of the repertoire to the highest standards, but commission and premiere the classics of the future, playing a unique part in moulding the musical landscape in Europe. Featuring the world's oldest radio orchestra, the BBC Philharmonic Orchestra, WDR's Symphony Orchestra, Yle Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra and RTP partner the Gulbenkian Orchestra, the series will tell their stories in a fresh and engaging way, intertwined with music that displays the orchestras' individuality and versatility, while shining a light on the cities and concert halls they perform in.
title: Eurovision Classical Concerts

overview: Sivert Eimhjellen is a hopeless and homeless comedian living below the poverty line. Now Morten Ramm wants to help him get both his life and his career back on track.
title: En nieu start

overview: A personal, unnerving and probing look at our own role in major, worldwide issues of war and peace, right and wrong, life and death.
title: I tjeneste for Norge

overview: Could you survive being handcuffed to a total stranger 24/7? In a brand-new social experiment, Jonathan Ross challenges 18 brave Brits to stay together, as they compete to win £100,000.
title: Handcuffed: Last Pair Standing

overview: Every night of the 2026 Milan Cortina Olympics, Primetime in Milan will showcase the biggest stars and most thrilling moments of the day's competition, with an emphasis on enhanced storytelling. Snoop Dog is returning to join Primetime in Milan most nights, giving a report after attending Olympic competitions or visiting with athletes and their friends and families. Stanley Tucci will also be on-site in northern Italy, spotlighting local cuisine, culture and lifestyle of the region.
title: Primetime in Milan: The Olympics

overview: Cyla Call Center In episodes that are sometimes funny and sometimes touching, the host and his guests take questions from callers, and the celebrities respond to the calls based on their own experiences, sensitivities, and personal perspectives, whether the questions are about dilemmas, family conflicts, workplace situations, life decisions, and taboo topics that are rarely discussed openly. The production is both entertaining and relatable, and the conversations are lighthearted and candid...
title: Cyla Call Center

overview: Officers tackle the thieves terrorising supermarkets and shops, with organised international crime groups stealing eye-watering amounts in increasingly industrial, brazen and sophisticated ways.
title: Police Interceptors: Taking Down the Shoplifting Gangs

overview: Deep beneath the streets of London sit thousands of highly classified and previously top-secret government files which disclose the details of extensive military, spy agency and police investigations into the paranormal. With hundreds of hours dedicated to examining these formerly off-limits documents from the National Archives, investigative journalist Tim Tate reveals just how far authorities on both sides of the Atlantic were willing to go to venture into the unknown. Combining his findings with expert insight from Dr David Clarke, Britain's X-Files fact-checks out-of-this-world phenomena with cases including the legend of the Flying Dutchman, Harry Grindell Matthews and his Death Ray, the Beast of Bodmin, Uri Geller, the Comet plane catastrophes, premonitions on the Aberfan disaster and more.
title: Britain's X Files

overview: P33 is a real estate firm where office dynamics are intertwined with personal relationships. Pattamon, a formidable manager admired by executives, clashes with Pitarn, a well-liked manager. Little do their colleagues know, they were once in a romantic relationship. Proud, the owner's daughter, returns from abroad and hires Jimmy, a highly educated young man, but she spends more time shopping than working. Proud develops feelings for Jimmy, who, in turn, is interested in her friend Am. The office is filled with stories of other employees and their relationships.
title: Office Syndrome

overview: Welcome to sunny Burnistoun! Robert Florence and Iain Connell write and perform a sketch show set in a strangely familiar Scottish town. Burnistoun has its own newspaper, its own radio station and even its own ice-cream van. Drop in and find out how to get a tattoo altered, what makes a good front-page headline, and why football songs are not a sexy choice for singers in girl groups.
title: Burnistoun

overview: Alexander Armstrong embarks on an epic journey across India to explore how a nation that gained independence 77 years ago is now a rising global superpower. With the world's largest population – 1.4 billion and counting - what do India's history, traditions, and people reveal about its rapid ascent?
title: Alexander Armstrong in India

overview: A mother-daughter vacation turns into a nightmare when 23-year-old Gali is arrested for drug smuggling in Moscow. Her mother, Orna, refuses to accept the charges — but her fight for Gali's freedom pulls her into a deadly web of crime and corruption.
title: Unconditional

overview: Enter NHRA's 330 MPH nitro world. Relive 2025 and Wally Parks' vision as the sport speeds toward its 75th anniversary.
title: Chasing Speed

overview: In a world where corruption is rampant and truth is crushed under an emperor indifferent to governance, a low-ranking government official, Sô Kô, quietly moves the wheels of destiny. Heeding the suffering of the people and wanting to save his nation, he creates a manifesto about justice and reform to aid those who have been trampled by unreasonable power. His loyal ally, Ro Chishin, travels the country to find like-minded comrades willing to rise up and take up this cause. This is a story of rebellion and reform, where the powerful and corrupt Song Regime as well as the secret organization "Seirenji" are the greatest obstacles.
title: Kitakata Kenzo Suikoden

overview: Film series built from the footage of video calls with the soldiers who were under encirclement at "Azovstal" in Mariupol. Since the beginning of the siege, the director has been having conversations with the "Azov" regiment fighters, thus creating their portraits. The most known episode is "Last Day At Azovstal" made in cooperation with soldier Dmytro «Orest» Kozatskyy.
title: Фортеця Маріуполь

overview: This series chronicles the story of the Islamic leader Khalid Bin Al Walid as he grows up into one of the greatest leaders of the Islamic conquests.
title: Khalid Bin Al Walid: Sayf Allah Al Masloul

overview: Orange County Choppers Original brings the legendary shop back to its roots -- real bikes, real stories, and the raw, unfiltered energy that made OCC a household name.
title: Orange County Choppers Original

overview: A cycle of ten documentary-fiction adaptations of works by Ukrainian poets and writers who went to war.
title: Війна-ненажера

overview: Sharp, no-nonsense, acerbic, loving and generous, Svetlana is a woman of indeterminate age (between 30 and 50, she'll never tell) who landed in Minnesota from the USSR years ago as a mail-order bride. She quickly left her humdrum life and milquetoast husband, Steve, for a life of edge and passion on the streets of Los Angeles — pursuing her version of the American dream — opening a brothel that caters to high end clients. And with that was born "St Petersburg House of Discreet Pleasure."
title: Svetlana

overview: A series of twelve short documentaries about a day in the life of Ukrainian soldiers, volunteers, social service workers and ordinary Ukrainian citizens in the combat zone. The heroes live their everyday lives, doing their usual things. As a result, we have a historical chronicle that will shape our understanding of the present in years to come.
title: Позиція Україна

overview: When a police academy student shoots and injures an aggressive young man during a violent arrest, the investigation ensues as case raises serious questions about the use of force and training of the police.
title: Uniformen

overview: Two highly decorated but vastly different FBI agents form an unlikely bond when they are assigned to a long-shuttered division devoted to cases involving unexplained phenomena.
title: X-Files

overview: Gifted with an exceptional talent for solving mysteries, the young prodigy Shi Wuming is invited to Tiandu City when a series of strange and violent cases shake the region. Together with Dali Temple official Su Xuelou, he delves into tangled clues and hidden motives. As the duo investigates deeper, they uncover layers of deception while navigating shifting alliances, moral dilemmas, and the complexities of justice in a turbulent city.
title: Tian Du Yi Wen Lu

overview: The project tells about spectacular victories and the most dramatic moments that happened to Soviet and Russian athletes at the Olympic Games. The series uses newsreels of tournaments, artistic reconstructions, and interviews with famous athletes and major sports figures.
title: Игры и люди

overview: The presenters travel around the country to find out how agribusiness works in Russia. The audience will see promising startups, learn about technological processes and visit different parts of the country.
title: За едой

overview: "They cheated on Me" is a reality experiment in which couples survived infidelity, saved their marriage, but did not return to happiness. Natalia Romanovskaya, a clinical psychologist, sexologist, and gestalt therapist, will help you open your feelings, regain trust, and restore intimacy.
title: Мне изменили

In each episode, the three meet each other for the first time. Fate brings them together in a precarious situation where they are completely dependent on each other. Unity of time and place form each time the fixed reference.Each episode revolves around one location, one situation: a car accident, a tour of a period house that is for sale, too long a driving lesson, too great a hospital room, an elevator that is stuck and a roof as a springboard to escape reality . In those six different arenas, the three sliding down again to the point that the only question that counts "And what now?". And while they search for an answer to that question, she seemed bothered by their language, which seems to be a good means of communication in all but clinch. On the contrary. With the passage of time, is an increasingly further search solution and get the main characters at the end of their tether. And when you do finally threatens the redemption, there is a brutal corpse.Out of the closet. CLINCH is the ultimate proof that fate has an extraordinary talent for creating embarrassing situations. And those embarrassing situations lead to humor. Which is painful turn. Roy Aernouts - theater, comedian, actor, writer and musician - is to clinch his debut as a screenwriter. Herwig Ilegems, takes just as in his previous DUTS Canvas series, directed by itself. Herwig has years of experience as a theater actor and is known for his roles in more of flesh and blood and with her husband and Power. Soon he will also be seen in the new police series T. (one). The leading roles are played by Roy Aernouts itself, Wim Helsen and Nico Sturm. CLINCH will be on display from mid-February on Canvas.
title: Clinch

overview: At the heart of the Monster Spectacular, Matthew Arel and his team juggle challenges, breakdowns, and fearless athletes.
title: Monster Trucks en tournée

overview: When a next door neighbor mysteriously dies one day, the next day a puzzling box has been placed in front of everyone's room. The innocent ones are blamed. Because the sender listed on the box is their dead neighbor, they each have to investigate who sent these boxes to everyone and what is inside each of them.
title: The Box

overview: Experts reveal what members of the royal family are saying when they think nobody is listening, including whispered exchanges caught at weddings, funerals and state occasions.
title: Lip-Reading The Royals: What Are They Really Saying?

overview: Gesha Korostylev works as a security guard in the regional administration and is raising a daughter with his wife, Lucy. He has endured ridicule from others all his life, because he has achieved nothing. Everything changes when Gesha finds out that his great-grandfather was Colonel Caesar. The fact that the stress falls on another syllable does not bother the guard, because he has already guessed that he is descended from the famous Roman commander. Gesha decides that the "descendant" of the legendary personality cannot live as before, so he leaves home, meets love in the person of businesswoman Cleopatra and finds a new vocation — to help the villagers.
title: Цезарь

overview: When a cold-hearted, playboy Vice President sets out to save his collapsing company, he captures a beautiful young man from a rare flower tribe—an enchanting being whose natural fragrance mesmerizes everyone around him—to create a revolutionary perfume. But he soon discovers that the fragrance blooms most powerfully only in moments of true love. Determined to exploit this secret, the Vice President schemes to steal the young man's heart, unaware that behind the delicate beauty lies a poisonous thorn—one who harbors a calculated desire for revenge against those who destroyed his village, including the man he is beginning to fall for.
title: Flower Boy

overview: Song of the Samurai is a live-action adaptation that translates this deep legacy to the screen. Set in Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, the story depicts the intense and passionate lives of the Shinsengumi - the iconic samurai force that defended Kyoto in the final years of Japan's shogunate - through spectacular action and a bold interpretation based on historical facts. The story follows street brawler Toshizo Hijikata, who finds a new kind of family in Isami Kondo and Soji Okita. Hijikata and his comrades in the Shinsengumi forge a bond of loyalty - tested by betrayal, illness, and war - as they fight not only their enemies but their own ideals.
title: Song of the Samurai

overview: Marseille, Present Day. Malik, a 17-year-old Comorian orphan is the sole survivor of a building collapse that housed an important drug deal. In the rubble, Malik is found with bags of cocaine planted on his body. He is directly sent to prison. Frail and illiterate, he must now find allies to ensure his survival in a grueling environment where clan hierarchy reigns supreme. Despite his precarious situation, Malik learns to navigate his way through the system. He gains power rapidly, and soon develops a taste for the inner workings of the criminal world.
title: Un prophète

overview: The stories of some of Ireland's most renowned con-artists and white collar criminals, told by their victims, friends and colleagues they deceived, journalists that covered the cases and the law enforcers who brought them to justice.
title: Swindlers

overview: Stricken with a terminal illness, Chen Fan gets a second chance at life when he is reborn in the year 2000. Reunited with Su Ruochu, his "first love", school beauty, desk mate who tragically died in a car accident in his previous life. He vows to rewrite their fate. Starting from nothing, he sets out to build a business empire, determined to give the girl he adores the perfect love and future they were robbed of.
title: Reborn in 2000: Crush on My Deskmate

overview: Ross Kemp: Lost Boys, Deadly Men blends true crime with an investigation into the crisis in masculinity affecting young men in Britain, emerging at a time when violence against women and girls has been declared a national emergency. While high-profile tragedies often spark public debate and political action, Ross questions the conclusions frequently drawn by the media and politicians about what drove those men to kill.
title: Ross Kemp: Lost Boys, Deadly Men

overview: Dr. Day is at a crossroads in life between her once clear dreams and her present exhausting reality. Just when she's on the verge of giving up, she receives a call from Dr. Ake, a doctor from the past who once devoted himself to providing medial care in remote areas.
title: The Bonded Doctor

overview: Aggression, ambition and allies. Western Europe has long played a central role on the global stage, but how will it confront the challenges of a turbulent new era?
title: Europe on the Edge with Katya Adler

overview: Documentary pitting two similar companies against one another each week.
title: Battle of the Brands

overview: How the world sounds... Ukraine is a completely new format, a musical journey. Musician and composer Yevgen Filatov (The Maneken, Onuka) collects the sounds of Ukrainian cities and creates a melody from them. And you watch it. This is an online demonstration of the magic of creating a composition from random sounds performed by Yevgen Filatov.
title: Як звучить світ... Україна

overview: Set against the charming backdrop of North Carolina, Bride Wars follows a big-city wedding planner whose arrival in a small town sparks an epic showdown with a beloved local planner. As the two women battle to plan the same wedding, their rivalry quickly escalates into a larger clash over friendship, community, and, ultimately, love.
title: Bride Wars

overview: As children, the "Little Prince" and the nursemaid's son were inseparable — their innocent first love blooming quietly within the palace walls. But their bond was torn apart by rigid traditions and the unyielding divide of rank and duty. Years later, they grow up in a kingdom on the brink of change. One has become a prince bound by responsibility and royal expectations, while the other longs for a life of freedom beyond the palace gates. When fate brings them face to face again amid a turbulent turning point in the nation's history, the feelings they once buried begin to bloom once more. But in a world ruled by hierarchy, honor, and unspoken rules, their love may be the one thing the kingdom cannot allow. Can love truly take root in a land where it is forbidden to exist?
title: The Edge of Horizon

overview: Kanfah, the grandson of a respected herbal doctor, travels to Wiang Asawa and becomes entangled in a political murder where a mysterious man named Thayu is falsely accused. After Thayu is poisoned by a venomous spider, Kanfah saves him, forcing the two to flee together through the dangerous highlands of Mueang Mang. As they uncover a conspiracy tied to the teak trade and local superstition, their partnership deepens into trust and quiet affection. Together, they must expose the real killer before the region descends into conflict.
title: Mon Merng Mang
Zhen Qian Jin De Yang Fu Mu Shi Shi You Da Wang

overview: First Up with Angie Lau is Bloomberg Television's award winning evening show that analyzes all the breaking news stories essential for your business day ahead at the Asian market open.
title: First Up with Angie Lau
Lian Qi Lian Le San Qian Nian

overview: Ye Man, a calculating stepbrother, deliberately works his way into Lu Zhu's life. Meanwhile, her ruthless stepmother relentlessly strips away everything she holds dear, her reputation, her status, even her family ties, leaving her world on the verge of collapse. Yet the true twist lies in the unexpected. The strategist loses control and falls desperately in love with the very girl he once intended to scheme against. As ambition and desire collide, this forbidden love struggles to breathe in the shadows, uncertain whether it can ever step into the light.
title: Love in A Secret

overview: When the charming and charismatic Hia Fu tries to woo MooMoo, who longs for a normal life, Moo finds himself constantly surrounded by Fu's hilarious and mischievous antics. What tricks will this love-struck Hia Fu use to win MooMoo's heart?
title: Crazy Love, Moo-Moo!

overview: Satang is a creditor who wants to open a cafe, and Job is the unlucky guy stuck with his ex's debt. When Satang realizes her new debtor is actually her favorite YouTuber who is also opening a coffee shop, she seizes the opportunity. She invests in his shop to pursue her own dream and to make sure he does not run away without paying.
title: Chasing Love, Chasing Cash

overview: Betrayal. Bitterness. Backstabbing. A real-life Shakespearean drama unfolds in this blow-by-blow account of the battle for Rupert Murdoch's empire.
title: Dynasty: The Murdochs

overview: Sequeira, a major businessman in the finishes industry, is found dead near the Santo Inácio Zoo, in Avintes. On his body, two clues are discovered: a red fingernail and a photograph of a mysterious woman. Guedes, a private detective, is hired to solve the crime. Who is the mysterious woman? Where is the former Dragão Sandinense, Crespo? And most importantly, where is Sequeira's fortune?
title: Sangue & Mármore

overview: Fast Money is a lively hour of exchange and debate takes place among four of Wall Street's leading traders. Segments include a look at the day's business-related stories in Page Two; the Takedown, in which panelists disagree and argue their points; the Chart of the Day, which offers a look at the stock of the day; and Trade School, in which host Melissa Lee defines Wall Street jargon used by a panelist or a guest.
title: Fast Money

overview: A troubled teen faces terror when her nightmare stalker becomes her family's charming houseguest. As her parents fall for his act, she fights to expose his true nature, leading to a startling revelation.
title: Secret Stories: Roslin
